description: Evaluation cases for the policy assistant. A doc_ case has facts that appear in the synthetic wordings written by src/jobs/generate_policy_docs.py (a test checks it); a claim_ case needs the UC function over the claims data.

inputs.question: What is the standard excess on the Motor Comprehensive policy?

What is the excess for storm or flood damage under the Home Building and Contents policy, and how long is the waiting period?
How much does the Home Building and Contents policy pay for one portable valuable that is not on the schedule?
How long do I have to lodge a claim under the Home Building and Contents policy?
What is the trip cancellation limit on the Travel policy?
What is the most the Travel policy pays for any one item of luggage?
For how long does the Landlord policy pay loss of rent when the property cannot be lived in?
How much are the contents of a caravan covered for under the Caravan and Trailer policy?
What is the status of claim CLM0000001?

expected_facts: The answer states the status of claim CLM0000001, taken from the claims data
